ATL.name: Mouhamed Gueye
ATL.note: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Henri Veesaar
ATL.note: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

BOS.name: Devin Carter
BOS.note: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

BKN.name: Tyler Bilodeau
BKN.note: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

CHA.name: Coby White
CHA.note: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

CHA.name: Kon Knueppel
CHA.note: Knueppel (hamstring) is without a timetable for a return, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

CHA.name: Grant Williams
CHA.note: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.

CHA.name: Kylan Boswell
CHA.note: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

CHI.name: Patrick Williams
CHI.note: Williams (groin) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

CHI.name: Nic Claxton
CHI.note: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

DAL.name: Naji Marshall
DAL.note: Marshall (illness) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Heat.

DAL.name: Sergio de Larrea
DAL.note: De Larrea (knee) won't return to Monday's game against the Heat. He'll finish with zero points (0-1 FG) and one rebound across six minutes.

DAL.name: Caleb Martin
DAL.note: Martin (thumb) is out for Monday's game against the Heat, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

DAL.name: Tarik Biberovic
DAL.note: Biberovic (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against San Antonio.

DAL.name: Santi Aldama
DAL.note: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.

DAL.name: Dereck Lively II
DAL.note: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

DEN.name: Cameron Johnson
DEN.note: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.

DEN.name: Alpha Diallo
DEN.note: Diallo (wrist) is out for Monday's game against the Warriors.

DEN.name: Spencer Jones
DEN.note: Jones (hamstring) is progressing in his recovery and could be back with the team within the next three games, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

DEN.name: Julian Strawther
DEN.note: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

DET.name: Isaiah Joe
DET.note: Joe (hip) is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Knicks.

DET.name: Ausar Thompson
DET.note: Thompson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Tuesday's game against New York.

DET.name: Jalen Duren
DET.note: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

GSW.name: Kristaps Porzingis
GSW.note: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

GSW.name: Moses Moody
GSW.note: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

GSW.name: Jimmy Butler III
GSW.note: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

HOU.name: Marcus Smart
HOU.note: Smart (arm) is out for Monday's game against the Hawks.

HOU.name: Steven Adams
HOU.note: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

IND.name: Ivica Zubac
IND.note: The Pacers don't have a timetable for Zubac's return after he suffered a left ankle injury Sunday against Brooklyn, but he was able to walk without a boot Monday, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

IND.name: Andrew Nembhard
IND.note: Nembhard (neck/back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Milwaukee, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

IND.name: Ben Sheppard
IND.note: Sheppard is scheduled for surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee Wednesday, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

IND.name: T.J. McConnell
IND.note: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Bucks.

IND.name: Johnny Furphy
IND.note: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

LAC.name: Bradley Beal
LAC.note: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

LAC.name: Max Strus
LAC.note: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

LAC.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
LAC.note: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

LAC.name: Brandon Ingram
LAC.note: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

LAC.name: Jordan Miller
LAC.note: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

LAL.name: Adou Thiero
LAL.note: Thiero (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Portland.

MIN.name: Donte DiVincenzo
MIN.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

NOP.name: Yves Missi
NOP.note: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

NYK.name: Jose Alvarado
NYK.note: Alvarado (ankle) is out for Tuesday's game against the Pistons.

OKC.name: Alex Caruso
OKC.note: Caruso won't return to Monday's game against the Suns due to a right ankle sprain, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports. He'll finish with nine points (3-5 FG, 3-5 3Pt), three assists and two rebounds in nine minutes.

OKC.name: Jalen Williams
OKC.note: Williams has been diagnosed with a dislocated left ankle and fractured fibula, which will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

OKC.name: Cason Wallace
OKC.note: Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

OKC.name: Nikola Topic
OKC.note: Topic (back) won't play in Monday's game against the Suns, Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic reports.

OKC.name: Thomas Sorber
OKC.note: Sorber (knee) is out for Monday's game versus the Suns, per Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic.

OKC.name: Chet Holmgren
OKC.note: Holmgren (knee) is out for Monday's game versus the Suns.

OKC.name: Otega Oweh
OKC.note: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.

ORL.name: Jalen Suggs
ORL.note: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

ORL.name: Jonathan Isaac
ORL.note: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Knicks.

ORL.name: Paolo Banchero
ORL.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

ORL.name: Noah Penda
ORL.note: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

ORL.name: Izaiyah Nelson
ORL.note: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

PHI.name: Jabari Walker
PHI.note: Walker has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pistons due to left knee soreness.

PHI.name: VJ Edgecombe
PHI.note: Edgecombe (abdomen) is out for Sunday's game against the Pistons, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

PHI.name: Joel Embiid
PHI.note: Embiid has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Detroit due to right plantar fasciitis management.

PHI.name: Tacko Fall
PHI.note: Fall (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Detroit.

PHI.name: Dominick Barlow
PHI.note: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

PHI.name: Ariel Hukporti
PHI.note: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

PHX.name: Oso Ighodaro
PHX.note: Ighodaro (oblique) is out for Monday's matchup with the Thunder.

PHX.name: Mark Williams
PHX.note: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

POR.name: Chris Youngblood
POR.note: Youngblood (ankle/two-way player) is out for Tuesday's game against the Lakers.

POR.name: Branden Carlson
POR.note: Carlson (concussion) is listed as questionable for Tuesday's game against the Lakers.

POR.name: Scoot Henderson
POR.note: Henderson is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Lakers due to left ankle soreness.

POR.name: Shaedon Sharpe
POR.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

SAC.name: Dylan Cardwell
SAC.note: Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

SAC.name: Maxime Raynaud
SAC.note: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

SAC.name: Keegan Murray
SAC.note: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

SAC.name: Ben Simmons
SAC.note: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

SAS.name: Tobias Harris
SAS.note: Harris (calf) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Kings.

SAS.name: Jayden Quaintance
SAS.note: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

TOR.name: Kawhi Leonard
TOR.note: Leonard is out for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to left knee swelling, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

TOR.name: Nate Bittle
TOR.note: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

UTA.name: Jaxson Hayes
UTA.note: Hayes (shoulder) is out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.

UTA.name: Lauri Markkanen
UTA.note: Markkanen (wrist) won't return to Monday's game against Memphis.

UTA.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
UTA.note: Jackson has been ruled out for the rest of Monday's game against the Grizzlies due to a right knee injury.

UTA.name: Trey Alexander
UTA.note: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

UTA.name: Jusuf Nurkic
UTA.note: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

WAS.name: Justin Champagnie

WAS.name: AJ Dybantsa
WAS.note: Dybantsa, who has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hornets, is progressing well from a left ankle sprain and will take part in on-court activities Tuesday, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

WAS.name: Tristan Vukcevic
WAS.note: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

WAS.name: Jamir Watkins
WAS.note: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
